description: This file defines the interface `SearchService` with methods for indexing, deleting indexes, searching for keywords, performing product searches, and initializing the search service within a sales management system.

classes.name: SearchService
classes.description: Interface for search-related operations, including indexing, deletion, keyword search, product search, and service initialization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product for a specific merchant store; invoked when a product is created or updated.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Deletes the product index in the appropriate language; invoked when a product is deleted.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves similar keywords based on a series of characters, used for autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a product search based on user input, store, language, and other parameters.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the search service to avoid lazy initialization.

calls: SearchResponse search(MerchantStore, String, String, int, int)
